operations.description:
Marks the specified alert for deletion. An alert that has been marked for
deletion is removed from Alert Center after 30 days.
Marking an alert for deletion has no effect on an alert which has
already been marked for deletion. Attempting to mark a nonexistent alert
for deletion results in a `NOT_FOUND` error.
operations.T: [METHOD] delete [NAME] alertcenter alerts delete [PATH] v 1beta 1 alerts [PARAMS] access alert alt callback customer fields id key oauth pretty print protocol quota token type upload user xgafv [SCHEMA]

[METHOD] get [NAME] alertcenter alerts list [PATH] v 1beta 1 alerts [PARAMS] access alt by callback customer fields filter id key oauth order page pretty print protocol quota size token type upload user xgafv [SCHEMA] alert alerts list metadata response

operations.description:
Gets the specified alert. Attempting to get a nonexistent alert returns
`NOT_FOUND` error.
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME] alertcenter alerts [PATH] v 1beta 1 alerts [PARAMS] access alert alt callback customer fields id key oauth pretty print protocol quota token type upload user xgafv [SCHEMA] alert metadata

operations.description:
Lists all the feedback for an alert. Attempting to list feedbacks for
a non-existent alert returns `NOT_FOUND` error.
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME] alertcenter alerts feedback list [PATH] v 1beta 1 alerts feedback [PARAMS] access alert alt callback customer fields filter id key oauth pretty print protocol quota token type upload user xgafv [SCHEMA] alert feedback list response

operations.description:
Returns the metadata of an alert. Attempting to get metadata for
a non-existent alert returns `NOT_FOUND` error.
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME] alertcenter alerts metadata [PATH] v 1beta 1 alerts metadata [PARAMS] access alert alt callback customer fields id key oauth pretty print protocol quota token type upload user xgafv [SCHEMA] alert metadata

[METHOD] get [NAME] alertcenter settings [PATH] v 1beta 1 settings [PARAMS] access alt callback customer fields id key oauth pretty print protocol quota token type upload user xgafv [SCHEMA] cloud notification pubsub settings topic

[METHOD] patch [NAME] alertcenter update settings [PATH] v 1beta 1 settings [PARAMS] access alt callback customer fields id key oauth pretty print protocol quota token type upload user xgafv [SCHEMA] cloud notification pubsub settings topic

operations.description:
Creates new feedback for an alert. Attempting to create a feedback for
a non-existent alert returns `NOT_FOUND` error. Attempting to create a
feedback for an alert that is marked for deletion returns
`FAILED_PRECONDITION' error.
operations.T: [METHOD] post [NAME] alertcenter alerts feedback create [PATH] v 1beta 1 alerts feedback [PARAMS] access alert alt callback customer fields id key oauth pretty print protocol quota token type upload user xgafv [SCHEMA] alert feedback

operations.description:
Restores, or "undeletes", an alert that was marked for deletion within the
past 30 days. Attempting to undelete an alert which was marked for deletion
over 30 days ago (which has been removed from the Alert Center database) or
a nonexistent alert returns a `NOT_FOUND` error. Attempting to
undelete an alert which has not been marked for deletion has no effect.
operations.T: [METHOD] post [NAME] alertcenter alerts undelete [PATH] v 1beta 1 alerts alert id undelete [PARAMS] access alert alt callback fields id key oauth pretty print protocol quota token type upload user xgafv [SCHEMA] alert metadata request undelete

operations.description: Performs batch delete operation on alerts.
operations.T: [METHOD] post [NAME] alertcenter alerts batch delete [PATH] v 1beta 1 alerts batch delete [PARAMS] access alt callback fields key oauth pretty print protocol quota token type upload user xgafv [SCHEMA] alerts batch delete request response

operations.description: Performs batch undelete operation on alerts.
operations.T: [METHOD] post [NAME] alertcenter alerts batch undelete [PATH] v 1beta 1 alerts batch undelete [PARAMS] access alt callback fields key oauth pretty print protocol quota token type upload user xgafv [SCHEMA] alerts batch request response undelete
